notes: Runtime-backed registry for identity and generation domains used by stale snapshot, restore, and rebind invariants.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Reject snapshots whose saved panel_generation does not match the panel-local generation marker before restore authority is applied.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Re-resolve by stable identity, then nearest visible ancestor, next visible sibling, previous visible sibling, and finally root visible node.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Canonical panel-anchor restore helpers commit panel-local selection, viewport, focus shape, and snapshot generation together.
migration_notes: Runtime panel_generation domain metadata is registered and validated against the canonical panel UI state record.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Treat any saved volume_generation mismatch as stale and require topology/payload identity re-resolution before panel snapshots are reused.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Keep the previous settled topology on blocked transitions; after invalidation, rebind panels through stable identities or fall back to root visible node.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Refresh/rebuild and mutation-result commits advance volume generation before panel restore consumers can observe the changed volume.
migration_notes: Runtime volume_generation domain metadata is registered and validated against Volume topology and payload commits.

generation_domains.owner_region: panel-local state plus volume/shared topology and payload state
generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Directory snapshots must compare stable path identity against the current volume generation before row or cursor state is trusted.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Exact directory identity, nearest visible ancestor, next visible sibling, previous visible sibling, then root visible node.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Directory rebind runs through panel-anchor helpers after the shared topology generation has settled.
migration_notes: Directory identity runtime metadata is registered with volume.volume_generation as the authoritative invalidation owner for topology changes.

generation_domains.owner_region: panel-local state plus volume/shared topology and payload state
generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: File snapshots must revalidate path/name identity and payload membership when volume generation changes.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Preserve the directory anchor when possible and choose a valid visible file only after exact file identity is unavailable.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: File identity restore is committed with the panel snapshot after topology or payload mutation has settled.
migration_notes: File identity runtime metadata is registered with volume.volume_generation as the authoritative owner for payload and namespace invalidation.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Saved focus shape is stale when panel_generation differs and must not be restored by transient render shape.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Restore the recorded panel shape directly or keep the current settled shape without rendering an intermediate guess.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Modal dismissal, panel reactivation, and rebind callbacks commit focus shape only through panel-local state.
migration_notes: Focus-shape runtime metadata is registered with panel.panel_generation as the current invalidation owner until a narrower focus-shape generation exists.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Modal and command targets may write panel or volume state only through a declared follow-up transition boundary.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: On blocked or failed command completion, preserve authoritative panel and volume state and write only declared message/modal fields.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Modal dismissal and command completion settle session state before any panel restore or refresh follow-up observes the result.
migration_notes: Modal command target runtime metadata is registered with panel.panel_generation guarding command paths that restore focus or queue panel-local follow-up work.

generation_domains.owner_region: panel-local state plus volume/shared topology and payload state
generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Visibility/filter changes that alter rendered rows invalidate saved panel anchors before any snapshot can be reused.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Rebind visible identity through the deterministic fallback order rather than deriving from hidden or filtered row indexes.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Visibility-filter commits update panel generation before rebind and render projection.
migration_notes: Visibility-filter runtime metadata is registered with panel.panel_generation as the panel-local invalidation owner for filter and dotfile visibility state.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Topology snapshots are invalid after any volume_generation advance and must be rebuilt or rebound by identity.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Blocked topology changes retain the previous settled tree; completed invalidation falls back panel anchors only after exact identity fails.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Topology rebuild commits settle volume.dir_tree and volume.logged_state before panel rebind callbacks run.
migration_notes: Topology runtime metadata is registered with volume.volume_generation representing Volume topology commit invalidation.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Payload cache identity must be revalidated on generation mismatch before saved file selection is restored.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: If payload cannot be loaded safely, preserve directory selection and leave file authority unchanged or empty according to current AppState.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Payload changes settle in Volume before panel file anchors are rebound.
migration_notes: File payload runtime metadata is registered with volume.volume_generation until a narrower payload generation field is registered.

generation_domains.owner_region: ctx/session state plus volume/shared topology and payload state
generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Panel volume bindings must resolve to an existing volume identity before per-volume snapshots can be restored.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: Do not orphan panel bindings; use deterministic volume fallback and then panel identity fallback after release or cycle invalidation.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Volume lifecycle transitions update registry/binding state before panel-local restore snapshots are applied.
migration_notes: Volume lifecycle runtime metadata is registered with volume.volume_generation as the shared invalidation owner while ctx.volumes_head remains the registry identity field.

generation_domains.stale_snapshot_policy: Layout reflow must project from settled AppState and may advance panel generation only for viewport bounds correction.
generation_domains.fail_closed_fallback: If safe projection cannot be computed, degrade or skip render without choosing new authoritative identities.
generation_domains.restore_boundary: Resize handling runs in the main loop and commits any viewport correction before render projection.
migration_notes: Render projection itself is read-only/projection-only and does not advance generations; terminal resize uses panel.panel_generation only when saved viewport origins are corrected.
Render projection-only coverage is registered explicitly even when no generation counter advances.
